extension.description: Clickable bracket and preprocessor (#if/#else/#endif) pairing hints for C.
configuration.title: Shigan
shigan.languages.description: Language ids Shigan is active for. Defaults to C only.
shigan.trigger.markdownDescription:
When to show pair hints (applies to both kinds).

- `cursor`: only the pair the caret is on. A bracket needs the caret on/next to it; a directive needs the caret anywhere on its line.
- `always`: every bracket pair that spans more than one line, plus every directive pair — nothing is hidden because of `#if` state. Brackets inside a disabled branch are simply not matched (see `shigan.preprocessor.skipInactiveBrackets`).
- `hover`: in the hover tooltip only.
- `off`: never.

Each segment of a hint is clickable (`}` -> `{`; `#else`/`#elif` -> the previous directive; on an `#endif`, `<-` -> the preceding branch and `<=` -> the opening `#if`).
shigan.show.description: Which kinds of pairs to hint: 'brackets' = ()[]{} and 'macros' = #if/#elif/#else/#endif.
shigan.compileFlags.markdownDescription: Compiler-style flags used when deciding which conditional branches are active, e.g. `["-DDEBUG=1", "-Iinclude", "-std=c11"]`. Mirrors clangd's `CompileFlags.Add`. Unknown flags are ignored. `${workspaceFolder}`, `${fileDirname}` and `${env:NAME}` are expanded.
shigan.inheritCompileCommands.descriptio: Also read -D/-I/-std from the nearest compile_commands.json for the current file. Flags from 'shigan.compileFlags' take precedence.
shigan.preprocessor.trackFileDefines.des: Evaluate #define/#undef found in the current file when deciding which conditional branches are active.
shigan.preprocessor.skipInactiveBrackets: Do not match brackets that sit inside a conditional branch which is known to be inactive (e.g. #if 0).
shigan.preprocessor.skipInactiveDirectiv: Hide the hint on #else/#elif/#endif when the branch (or, for #endif, the whole block) it refers to is inactive. Off by default: a directive line is live code, so its hint is shown even for a fully inactive #if 0 block.
shigan.preprocessor.markInactive.descrip: Append "(inactive)" to hints that refer to a branch/block which is known to be inactive.
shigan.showRange.description: Include the ':start-end' line range in the hint text.
shigan.showRangeThreshold.description: Hide the ':start-end' range when the opening and closing lines are at most this many lines apart (e.g. with 1, a pair on two adjacent lines hides the range). 0 always shows the range.
shigan.showLabel.description: Include the opening context in the hint text: the opening line's statement for brackets, the directive text (e.g. '#if X') for macros.
